events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The Iran conflict is escalating, with the US and Iran engaging in military actions. This escalation is expected to impact global markets, particularly oil prices. The conflict is also expected to affect the US dollar and gold prices.
events.reasoning: The Iran conflict is expected to disrupt oil supplies, leading to higher oil prices. This will also lead to a increase in gold prices as investors seek safe-haven assets. The US dollar is expected to be impacted, with potential for a decline in value.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and gold prices for exit signals

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or gold prices decline
